changes.evidence: Crop 02 shows curled upper and lower lobes with a short inward middle stroke; the right ends are curved rather than the straight three-arm membership form. The adjacent M has one typed contour and a separate underline. This resolves a C doubt, not an assertion that C selected a wrong definite glyph.

changes.evidence: Half a shows two sloping strokes meeting at a low vertex, with the right stroke rising higher. There is no second bend such as the neighboring wavy exponents have. C doubt resolved from the half without a crop.
changes.mathematical_consequence: The codomain retains the visible vee-shaped exponent even though neighboring categories have tilde marks.

changes.kind: deletion state (struck given live or live given struck)
changes.evidence: Crop 03 independently shows a tall h stem and shoulder, together with a g bowl and lower loop, occupying the same slot. Their overlap does not establish a secure strike order. Both letters are readable; only deletion order is doubtful.
changes.mathematical_consequence: No correction of the word is inferred from the expected mathematical term.

changes.locus: Item 4, cancelled phrase immediately after est
changes.evidence: Crop 06 exposes the u and n, all letters of sous-topos, the real hyphen, and the opening parenthesis beneath the typed x cancellation. The final reference is more heavily superposed, especially its punctuation, so the doubt is confined to 9.1. No closing parenthesis is supplied.

changes.locus: Item 5, left-margin (V 4.1) and paired marker after S(X)-acyclique
changes.evidence: Half b shows the reference in the left margin, next to a tall sloping stroke with a small loop at its top; a short horizontal stroke joins that mark toward the opening parenthesis. A second looped stroke stands directly after acyclique and before the full stop. Both marks and the left placement were missing from C.
changes.mathematical_consequence: The reference still attaches to the S(X)-acyclic assertion; its source geometry is retained.

notes.text: The continuation imposes a transitivity condition for a composite, and asks that phi_u be an isomorphism when u belongs to the underlined M in the source notation. The lowered round composition sign remains circle/o doubtful.
notes.basis: Observation: top continuation. No proof checked.

notes.text: Item 3 asks for restriction and prolongement functors, preservation of inductive and projective limits by Res, full faithfulness of Prol, and the stated essential-image condition. Mathematical type consistency drew attention to the Res codomain exponent; the actual two-stroke vee shape was retained. The isomorphisme overprint contains both g and h without secure order.
notes.basis: Observation and reading detector: item 3 display and remainder; not a proof check.

notes.text: Item 4 asks for the indicated adjunction, the displayed topos morphism, f*=Res_X and f_!=Prol_X, preservation of abelian sheaves by Prol, and a plongement with the small topos equivalent to a subtopos of the large one. The live reference is handwritten 9.1.1; the separate cancelled reference is not restored from it.
notes.basis: Observation: item 4; live reference verified in crop 05 and cancellation in crop 06. No adjunction or embedding theorem was proved.

notes.text: Item 5 asks that restriction of a flasque abelian sheaf be S(X)-acyclic, then asks for the canonical cohomology comparison. The handwritten left-margin reference (V 4.1) attaches after acyclique by matching looped marks. The raised O in MOntrer is preserved.
notes.basis: Observation: item 5, left margin, and crop 07; no cohomology proof check.
